tools.purpose: Headless AI-facing Mesen bridge for frame stepping, memory/register inspection, breakpoints, traces, and SNES code/data logging.

headless.note: The bridge/daemon is headless; actual Mesen hosting uses upstream's Xvfb-backed testrunner path when a Mesen binary is attached.

tools.purpose: Community-maintained Mesen continuation, pinned to the 2026-09-26 head because post-2.2.1 changes include SNES mid-scanline PPU fixes plus debugger/Lua fixes directly relevant to UR-Recomp validation.

headless.note: Pinned source remains manual; mesen-for-ai's supported Linux automation path launches Mesen/MesenCE under xvfb-run --testrunner. Do not promote a custom GUI-stripped build without measured benefit.

tools.purpose: Presentation/reference frontend for deterministic matched-frame capture through libretro cores and Slang shader presets. Use for comparative upscale/filter/NTSC/CRT evidence, not as an authoritative gameplay oracle.

headless.note: Keep off default CI initially. Promote only a measured capture path, likely Xvfb plus a software/GPU backend, once a deterministic screenshot experiment proves the runtime contract.

tools.purpose: Pinned Libretro Slang shader corpus for comparative pixel-art reconstruction, scaling, NTSC and CRT reference captures. Curate a small project-owned preset matrix rather than treating every shader as equally useful.

headless.note: Data-only shader checkout. Runtime headlessness depends on the frontend used to execute the presets.

tools.purpose: Specialist visual-reference workbench for HD Mode 7/high-resolution rendering experiments and clean layer/sprite isolation where its controls provide evidence unavailable from ordinary framebuffer scaling.

headless.note: Optional specialist workbench, not a default CI dependency. Use only when its higher-resolution/layer-isolation features materially answer a graphics question.
